# iosxe_controller (Resource)

This resource can manage the Controller configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_controller" "example" {
  type   = "T1"
  number = "0/1/0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `number` (String)
- `type` (String) - Choices: `E1`, `T1`, `T3`

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `e1_framing` (String) E1 framing. Only valid when `type` is `E1`. The device rejects setting the default `crc4`; use `no-crc4` to change it.
  - Choices: `crc4`, `no-crc4`
- `framing` (String) T1/T3 framing. Only valid when `type` is `T1` or `T3`.
  - Choices: `esf`, `sf`
- `pri_group_timeslots` (String) PRI group timeslots. Only valid when `type` is `T1` or `E1`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_controller.example "<type>,<number>"
```
